meaningId: Mengekspresikan kemampuan atau Kemungkinan ('bisa / tidak bisa').

notesEn.formation: Stem + ~ㄹ 수 있다/없다 (vowel stem) / ~을 수 있다/없다 (consonant stem).
notesEn.usage: Indicates whether one has the physical ability, skill, or possibility to perform an action.
notesEn.nuance: Use 있다 for 'can' and 없다 for 'cannot'.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar + ~ㄹ 수 있다/없다 (vokal) / ~을 수 있다/없다 (konsonan).
notesId.usage: Menunjukkan apakah seseorang memiliki kemampuan fisik, keterampilan, atau kemungkinan untuk melakukan suatu tindakan.
notesId.nuance: Gunakan 있다 untuk 'bisa' dan 없다 untuk 'tidak bisa'.

examples.meaningId: Saya tidak bisa makan makanan pedas.

quiz.question: How do you say 'I cannot eat' using this structure?
quiz.explanationEn: 먹다 stem (먹) ends in a consonant, so add ~을 수 없어요 -> 먹을 수 없어요.
quiz.explanationId: Kata dasar 먹다 (먹) berakhiran konsonan, jadi tambahkan ~을 수 없어요 -> 먹을 수 없어요.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I can speak Korean. -> 한국어를 하___ 수 있어요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: 하다 stem ends in a vowel, attach ~ㄹ underneath.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Kata dasar 하다 berakhiran vokal, tempelkan ~ㄹ di bawahnya.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I can speak Korean.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya bisa berbahasa Korea.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use Korean language (한국어를) + do (하) + ability can (ㄹ 수 있어요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan bahasa Korea (한국어를) + lakukan (하) + kemampuan bisa (ㄹ 수 있어요).

pattern: 못 + Verb / Verb Stem + ~지 못하다 (Inability / Cannot)
meaningEn: Inability due to external circumstances or lack of capability ('cannot').
meaningId: Ketidakmampuan karena keadaan luar atau kurangnya kemampuan ('tidak bisa').

notesEn.formation: 못 + Verb OR Verb Stem + ~지 못하다.
notesEn.usage: Expresses that an action cannot be performed despite the speaker's willingness, due to external factors or lack of ability.
notesEn.nuance: Different from 안 / ~지 않다 (don't/won't by choice); 못 indicates inability.

notesId.formation: 못 + Kata Kerja ATAU Kata Dasar + ~지 못하다.
notesId.usage: Mengekspresikan bahwa suatu tindakan tidak dapat dilakukan meskipun pembicara ingin, karena faktor luar atau kurangnya kemampuan.
notesId.nuance: Berbeda dari 안 / ~지 않다 (tidak mau berdasarkan pilihan); 못 menunjukkan ketidakmampuan.

examples.meaningEn: I am busy, so I cannot go.
examples.meaningId: Saya sibuk, jadi tidak bisa pergi.
Saya tidak bisa makan makanan pedas.

quiz.question: Which prefix specifically expresses 'cannot do something' (inability)?
quiz.explanationEn: 못 indicates inability (cannot), whereas 안 indicates strong choice or simple negation (don't).
quiz.explanationId: 못 menunjukkan ketidakmampuan (tidak bisa), sedangkan 안 menunjukkan pilihan atau negasi sederhana (tidak mau/melakukan).

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I couldn't sleep yesterday. -> 어제 ___ 잤어요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert the short inability prefix before 잤어요.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan awalan ketidakmampuan pendek sebelum 잤어요.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I couldn't sleep yesterday.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya tidak bisa tidur kemarin.'
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan kemarin (어제) + tidak bisa (못) + tidur lampau (잤어요).

pattern: Verb/Adj Stem + ~아/어/해야 하다 (Obligation / Must / Have to)

notesEn.formation: Stem with ㅏ/ㅗ -> ~아야 하다. Other vowels -> ~어야 하다. 하다 -> ~해야 하다.
notesEn.usage: States an obligation, duty, or necessity that the subject must perform.
notesEn.nuance: 하다 can be replaced with 되다 (~아/어/해야 되다) for a slightly less formal tone.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar bervokal ㅏ/ㅗ -> ~아야 하다. Vokal lain -> ~어야 하다. 하다 -> ~해야 하다.
notesId.usage: Menyatakan obligation, tugas, atau keharusan yang harus dilakukan oleh subjek.
notesId.nuance: 하다 dapat digantikan dengan 되다 (~아/어/해야 되다) untuk nada yang sedikit lebih informal.

examples.meaningEn: I have an exam tomorrow, so I have to study.
examples.meaningId: Karena besok ada ujian, saya harus belajar.

examples.meaningEn: I have to go home now.
examples.meaningId: Saya harus pulang ke rumah sekarang.

quiz.question: What is the obligation form ('have to go') for '가다'?
quiz.explanationEn: 가다 stem (가) ends in ㅏ, so add ~야 해요 -> 가야 해요.
quiz.explanationId: Kata dasar 가다 (가) berakhiran ㅏ, jadi tambahkan ~야 해요 -> 가야 해요.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I have to go home now. -> 지금 집에 가___ 해요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Attach the obligation suffix after the vowel stem 가.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Tempelkan akhiran keharusan setelah kata dasar vokal 가.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I have to go home now.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya harus pulang ke rumah sekarang.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use now (지금) + home to (집에) + have to go (가야 해요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan sekarang (지금) + ke rumah (집에) + harus pergi (가야 해요).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~아/어/해도 되다 (Permission / May / Allowed to)

notesEn.formation: Stem with ㅏ/ㅗ -> ~아도 되다. Other vowels -> ~어도 되다. 하다 -> ~해도 되다.
notesEn.usage: Asks for or grants permission to perform an action.
notesEn.nuance: Literal meaning is 'even if you do [action], it is fine/okay'.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar bervokal ㅏ/ㅗ -> ~아도 되다. Vokal lain -> ~어도 되다. 하다 -> ~해도 되다.
notesId.usage: Meminta atau memberikan izin untuk melakukan tindakan.
notesId.nuance: Arti harfiahnya adalah 'meskipun melakukan [tindakan], tidak apa-apa/boleh'.

examples.meaningId: Anda boleh pulang ke rumah sekarang.

quiz.question: Which structure means 'May I sit here?'
quiz.explanationEn: ~아/어/해도 돼요 asks for permission ('may I...'). 앉다 -> 앉아도 돼요?.
quiz.explanationId: ~아/어/해도 돼요 meminta izin ('bolehkah saya...'). 앉다 -> 앉아도 돼요?.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: May I sit here? -> 여기 앉___ 돼요?
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: 앉다 stem vowel is ㅏ, attach ~아도.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Vokal kata dasar 앉다 adalah ㅏ, tempelkan ~아도.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'May I sit here?'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Bolehkah saya duduk di sini?'
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan di sini (여기) + izin duduk (앉아도 돼요?).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~(으)면 안 되다 (Prohibition / Must not / Not allowed)
meaningEn: Prohibition or denial of permission ('must not / not allowed to').
meaningId: Larangan atau penolakan izin ('tidak boleh / dilarang').

notesEn.formation: Vowel stem -> ~면 안 되다 / Consonant stem -> ~으면 안 되다.
notesEn.usage: Expresses prohibition against a specific action.
notesEn.nuance: Literal meaning: 'If you do [action], it is not okay'.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~면 안 되다 / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~으면 안 되다.
notesId.nuance: Arti harfiah: 'Jika melakukan [tindakan], itu tidak boleh'.

examples.meaningEn: You must not take photos in the museum.
examples.meaningId: Dilarang mengambil foto di dalam museum.

quiz.question: How do you form prohibition ('must not smoke') for '피우다'?
quiz.explanationEn: 피우다 stem (피우) ends in a vowel, so attach ~면 안 돼요 -> 피우면 안 돼요.
quiz.explanationId: Kata dasar 피우다 (피우) berakhiran vokal, jadi tempelkan ~면 안 돼요 -> 피우면 안 돼요.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: You must not smoke here. -> 여기서 담배를 피우___ 안 돼요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Attach prohibition conditional suffix after vowel stem 피우.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Tempelkan akhiran syarat larangan setelah kata dasar vokal 피우.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'You must not smoke here.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Dilarang merokok di sini.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use here at (여기서) + cigarette (담배를) + smoke prohibition (피우면 안 돼요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan di sini (여기서) + rokok (담배를) + larangan merokok (피우면 안 돼요).
